svg.title: Interface occupation changes the entire equilibrium profile
svg.desc: Shared x in nm; Et is a localized marker, not a third spatial band. The displacement jump uses corrected interface limits. The sheet is separate from volume charge.

g.text: Interface occupation changes the entire equilibrium profile
Practice 08 A/B card: 300 K; h=1.25 nm; EF=-0.5 eV
A common potential must be re-solved
Et and bands use the same reference
Corrected one-sided D includes the sheet
Sheet = -3.1989014e-05 C/m², f = 0.249575; sheet is not plotted as volume rho.
Synthetic teaching inputs; equilibrium only. No measured Dit, biased DD or quantum confinement.
